label: Track A - Chapter I approval and extension
description: New institution and extension-of-approval cycle: scrutiny, deficiency loop, EVC, EC decision, appeal, Council, endorsement, Security Deposit.

states.label: Submitted (locked, TER paid, portal number issued)
Letter of Rejection recorded with Speaking Order

transitions.label: Submit application
transitions.description: TER paid, data locked and a portal number issued (APH 1.4.3).

transitions.label: Confirm TER payment
transitions.description: Verify that the computed TER has been paid before submission.

transitions.label: Assign the Scrutiny Committee
transitions.description: Regulation Bureau assigns a scrutiny member and opens scrutiny.

transitions.label: Communicate deficiencies (LoD)
transitions.description: Issue the Deficiency Report and pause the application.

transitions.label: Recommend an Expert Visit Committee
transitions.description: Scrutiny is clear; the Regional Officer constitutes the EVC.

transitions.label: Clear scrutiny without an EVC
transitions.description: This route does not require an Expert Visit Committee.

transitions.label: Submit compliance
transitions.description: Respond to every open deficiency with evidence.

transitions.label: Verify the listed deficiencies
transitions.description: Re-Scrutiny checks only the deficiencies that were communicated.

transitions.label: Verify another listed deficiency
transitions.description: Remaining deficiencies are verified one by one in Re-Scrutiny.

transitions.label: Close Re-Scrutiny and constitute the EVC
transitions.description: All deficiencies are closed; the file moves to the EVC.

transitions.label: Close Re-Scrutiny without an EVC
transitions.description: All deficiencies are closed; this route has no EVC.

transitions.label: Upload the EVC video
transitions.description: The visit video must be at least 30 minutes long (APH 1.9f-g).

transitions.label: Submit the EVC report
transitions.description: Record findings only after the 30-minute video is uploaded.

transitions.label: Place Regulation Bureau observations
transitions.description: The Bureau places observations before the EC.

transitions.label: List before the Executive Committee
transitions.description: The case is placed on the EC agenda.

transitions.label: Decide to approve (LoA)
transitions.description: The EC records an approval decision; no conditional approval exists.

transitions.label: Decide a Letter of Deficiency
transitions.description: The EC records deficiencies rather than rejecting outright.

transitions.label: Decide to reject (LoR)
transitions.description: The EC records a rejection with a Speaking Order.

transitions.label: Ratify the EC decision (Council secretariat)
transitions.description: Ratification requires an EC decision with a met quorum. The super admin has no operational approval or rejection power.

transitions.label: Issue the Letter of Approval
transitions.description: Issue the LoA and start the 15-day Security Deposit clock.

transitions.label: Issue the Letter of Deficiency
transitions.description: Issue the LoD and start the seven-day appeal clock.

transitions.label: Issue the re-examined Letter of Deficiency
transitions.description: The institution already used its single appeal, so the re-examined decision returns to the SAC for its final recommendation.

transitions.label: Issue the Speaking Order (LoR)
transitions.description: Issue the LoR with the Speaking Order and appeal deadline.

transitions.label: Issue the re-examined Speaking Order
transitions.description: The institution already used its single appeal, so the re-examined decision returns to the SAC for its final recommendation.

transitions.label: Record the ratified approval
transitions.description: The EC records the ratified decision without a second vote.

transitions.label: Record the ratified deficiency letter
transitions.description: The EC records the ratified deficiency decision.

transitions.label: Record the ratified rejection
transitions.description: The EC records the ratified rejection.

transitions.label: Issue the final Letter of Approval
transitions.description: The final LoA starts the Security Deposit clock.

transitions.label: File appeal with the SAC
transitions.description: One appeal only, within the configured seven-day window.

transitions.label: Finalise without appeal (LoA)
transitions.description: If no appeal is filed, the decision becomes final automatically.

transitions.label: Finalise without appeal (LoD)
transitions.description: A deficiency decision becomes final after the appeal window.

transitions.label: Finalise without appeal (LoR)
transitions.description: If no appeal is filed, the decision becomes final automatically.

transitions.label: Send the case back once
transitions.description: The SAC may send the case back once; a second send-back is not allowed (Annexure-7).

transitions.label: Record the SAC recommendation
transitions.description: The SAC recommends; the Council records the final decision.

transitions.label: Record the Council's final decision
transitions.description: The Council decision is final. The EC member records it in the Council secretariat capacity; the super admin only ratifies EC decisions.

transitions.label: Endorse the final approval
transitions.description: The Regional Officer endorses; they do not approve or reject.

transitions.label: Endorse the final deficiency letter
transitions.description: The Regional Officer endorses; they do not approve or reject.

transitions.label: Endorse the final rejection
transitions.description: The Regional Officer endorses; they do not approve or reject.

transitions.label: Pay Security Deposit and file Affidavit 3
transitions.description: Proof and Affidavit 3 are due within 15 days; the deposit is 10% penalised to 31 May and 20% to 31 July.

transitions.label: Apply the Security Deposit penalty
transitions.description: Scheduler action: 10% to 31 May, 20% to 31 July.

transitions.label: Withdraw approval after the final deposit date
transitions.description: After 31 July the approval may be withdrawn (APH 2.25f).

transitions.label: Cancel the LoA after two academic years
transitions.description: An LoA is valid for two academic years; the next year is EoA.

transitions.label: Reopen a wrongly submitted application (once)
transitions.description: Reopen once, after a fresh TER and late penalty, so the institution can correct the data (APH 2.3.3d-e).

label: Track B - EoA by self-disclosure
description: Existing institution: automatic self-disclosure Deficiency Report, optional random EVC, compliance window, EC listing and EoA.

states.label: Submitted (locked, TER paid, portal number issued)

transitions.label: Submit application
transitions.description: TER paid, data locked and a portal number issued.

transitions.label: Confirm TER payment
transitions.description: No EoA can be processed before the TER is paid.

transitions.label: Run the self-disclosure check
transitions.description: Generate the automatic Deficiency Report; a Nil Deficiency declaration is required before the EC can list the case.

transitions.label: Communicate the Deficiency Report
transitions.description: Open the compliance window for every deficiency found.

transitions.label: Submit compliance evidence
transitions.description: Respond to every open deficiency; the Bureau re-runs the check.

transitions.label: Verify a responded deficiency
transitions.description: The Bureau verifies each responded self-disclosure deficiency before the case can be cleared (APH 1.8, 2.4).

transitions.label: Select a random EVC
transitions.description: A configurable percentage of self-disclosure cases get a random EVC.

transitions.label: Clear the self-disclosure check
transitions.description: Nil Deficiency or all deficiencies closed; list before the EC.

transitions.label: Submit the random EVC report
transitions.description: Record the visit findings and list the case before the EC.

transitions.label: List before the Executive Committee
transitions.description: The consolidated list records the Approved Intake.

transitions.label: Decide to extend approval (EoA)
transitions.description: EoA requires the last-date check, no pending investigation and three core branches for Engineering & Technology.

transitions.label: Decide to reject with a Speaking Order
transitions.description: The EC records a rejection with reasons.

transitions.label: Issue the Extension of Approval
transitions.description: Publish the EoA letter and mark the approval active.

transitions.label: Issue the Speaking Order
transitions.description: Publish the LoR and start the seven-day appeal clock.

transitions.label: Issue the re-examined Speaking Order
transitions.description: The institution already used its single appeal, so the re-examined decision returns to the SAC for its final recommendation.

transitions.label: Issue the final approval after appeal
transitions.description: The Council decision is final; publish the EoA letter.

transitions.label: File appeal with the SAC
transitions.description: One appeal only, within the configured seven-day window.

transitions.label: Record the Council's final decision
transitions.description: The Council decision is final. The EC member records it in the Council secretariat capacity; the super admin only ratifies EC decisions.

transitions.label: Endorse the final approval
transitions.description: The Regional Officer endorses; they do not approve or reject.

transitions.label: Endorse the final deficiency letter
transitions.description: The Regional Officer endorses; they do not approve or reject.

transitions.label: Endorse the final rejection
transitions.description: The Regional Officer endorses; they do not approve or reject.

transitions.description: Reopen once, after a fresh TER and late penalty, so the institution can correct the data (APH 2.3.3d-e).
